description: Claim of quantum advantage without proper baseline

input.claim: Our quantum-enhanced model achieves 23% improvement over the previous state-of-the-art, demonstrating clear quantum advantage

expected_output.claim_attack: Improvement over previous SOTA does not demonstrate quantum advantage without classical baseline comparison
expected_output.alternative_explanation: Improvement may come from better training, larger model, or architectural changes unrelated to quantum component
expected_output.falsification_experiment: Perform ablation study: remove quantum component while keeping all other factors constant; compare to classical equivalent baseline
expected_output.abandonment_condition: If classical equivalent matches or exceeds performance, quantum advantage claim fails

notes: Quantum advantage requires ablation study, not just improvement over previous work
